fs_domain.description: The account this app is installed in, e.g. yora.freshservice.com

zd_email.description: The agent the API token belongs to; notes appear as this agent

zd_api_token.description: Admin Center → Apps and integrations → Zendesk API

requester_email.description: Incidents are raised as this requester, e.g. the support team mailbox

it_group_id.description: Optional Freshservice group for escalated incidents

webhook_token.description: Long random string; the Zendesk webhook sends it in the X-Bridge-Token header
